canonical_project: Yamoussoukro Datacenter for public university / virtual university services
owner: Orange Cote d'Ivoire / Ministry of Communication, Digital Economy and Post / ANSUT
notes: Open Government Partnership IRM reporting for the 2016-2018 Cote d'Ivoire action plan says installation of several datacenters to house services was substantially implemented, with a work order for Orange Cote d'Ivoire to carry out work on the Yamoussoukro Datacenter and a government document indicating completion at that center. The related environmental report describes a Yamoussoukro technopole datacenter site as a fallback/DRP site for Grand-Bassam workloads.
